data_description.device_profile: Select the appropriate device profile for your Zendure system. Control parameters are adjusted automatically.
data_description.soc_entity: Sensor providing the current battery State of Charge in percent.
data_description.soc_limit_entity: Optional status sensor detecting active BMS limits from the Zendure integration.
data_description.pack_capacity_kwh: Usable capacity of a single battery pack in kWh. Multiplied by the number of installed packs.
data_description.installed_pv_wp: Installed peak power of the PV system in Wattpeak. Used for future optimizations.
data_description.battery_ac_power_entity: Sensor providing battery AC power in watts. Value must be positive during discharge.
data_description.pv_entity: Sensor providing current PV power in watts. Used to detect surplus.
data_description.additional_battery_charge_entity: Sensor providing current charge power of the second battery in watts (e.g. BYD).
data_description.additional_battery_discharge_entity: Sensor providing current discharge power of the second battery in watts.
data_description.wallbox_power_entity: Sensor providing current wallbox charge power in watts. Prevents Zendure discharge during active vehicle charging.
data_description.pv_forecast_entity: Solcast or other PV forecast sensor (today's generation in kWh). Basis for PV-aware night charging.
data_description.pv_daily_yield_entity: Sensor providing the actual daily PV yield (kWh). Stored at sunset and used as fallback forecast when no Solcast sensor is available.
data_description.additional_battery_soc_entity: Sensor providing the State of Charge of the second battery in percent (e.g. BYD HVS).
data_description.additional_battery_capacity_kwh: Total capacity of the second battery in kWh. Required for night charge calculations. 0 = not present.
data_description.additional_battery_mode_entity: input_select to control the operating mode of the second battery (charge / automatic / pause).
data_description.additional_battery_power_entity: input_number to set the charge power of the second battery in watts.
data_description.additional_battery_charge_mode: Exact text value of the charge mode in the input_select (e.g. 'Laden'). Must match exactly.
data_description.additional_battery_stop_mode: Exact text value of the normal mode in the input_select (e.g. 'Automatik'). Set after night charging completes.
data_description.additional_battery_pause_mode: Exact text value of the pause mode in the input_select (e.g. 'Pause'). Prevents discharge during Zendure night charging.
data_description.price_export_entity: Sensor providing price forecast data for upcoming hours. Enables intelligent charge planning.
data_description.price_now_entity: Sensor providing the current electricity price (€/kWh). Enables price-based discharge.
data_description.ac_mode_entity: Select entity from the Zendure integration switching between INPUT and OUTPUT mode.
data_description.input_limit_entity: Number entity to set Zendure charge power in watts.
data_description.output_limit_entity: Number entity to set Zendure discharge power in watts.
data_description.grid_mode: Determines how grid import and export are measured.
data_description.grid_power_entity: Combined grid sensor (positive = import, negative = export).
data_description.grid_import_entity: Grid import sensor in watts (split mode).
data_description.grid_export_entity: Grid export sensor in watts (split mode).
